描述_EN: laurence xu plays with the well-known motifs from the most traditional chinese garment, the dragon robe, in this sumptuous evening dress. another classic motif, the rolling waves at the hem, fittingly cascades down the long flowing train. the dragon robe was full of symbols and the most important of them, the dragon, coils around the body here in a modern take of the full-frontal motif. the dragon robe (known as jifu) of the qing dynasty (1644-1911) was worn during auspicious events by the emperor, his immediate family and by members of the government élite. this is an eye-catching example of the luxury fashion popular in contemporary china, and also illustrates the growing interest chinese have in their cultural heritage.
描述_ZN: Laurence Xu在这件华美的晚礼服中使用了中国最传统的服装--龙袍的著名图案。 另一个经典的图案，下摆处滚动的波浪，恰如其分地从长长的流线型裙裾上垂下。 龙袍充满了象征意义，其中最重要的是龙，在这里以现代的方式围绕着身体的正面图案。 清朝（1644-1911）的龙袍（被称为吉福）是由皇帝、他的直系亲属和政府精英成员在吉利事件中穿着的。 这是在当代中国流行的奢侈时尚的一个引人注目的例子，也说明了中国人对他们的文化遗产越来越感兴趣。
